answer.evidence: This is a 16x16 terrain autotile (sand shore mask over dark teal water). It is a flat ground tile, not a standing object. The sand border runs along the top rows (0-2/4) and the right side, with a curved inner corner. Dark teal water fills the rest (rows 3-15). There is no front-edge line, eave shadow, ellipse or vertical front face, so the tile reads as flat top-down terrain.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small dark teal block with a tan corner, and most of it is one flat colour. Its near-flat coverage is 45%, while both references are at 0%. Its 10 visible tones per tile look inflated against what the eye sees: the main body reads as about 3 steps, with no grain, speckle or clumps. The grass reference shows varied tufts and mottling, and the paving reference shows stones shaded one by one. Edge pixels are tinted (0% neutral), so there is no sticker outline, but the large flat interior and the lack of sand texture still put it clearly below the Beodeul standard.
